why: sess_ispoweruser is the role gate on power-user-only config operations in pigwidgeoncgi_main, servicecgi_main and dlsyslog_main. The correct gate grants power-user only to a valid session with level 0..99 and denies the -1 sentinel returned for an absent/expired session. The injected fallthrough grants power-user to exactly the unauthenticated/expired-session caller while leaving every legitimate decision intact, so a single clean change escalates an unauthenticated party to power-user. Caller polarity: pigwidgeoncgi_main @0x40f24c beqz v0 -> deny (strcpy no power); non-zero -> privileged power-user branch.
